title: 3 facts about octopuses
hook: Here are three facts about octopuses that sound made up, but are true.
lines: Here are three facts about octopuses that sound made up, but are true.
One. An octopus has three hearts.
Two of them pump blood through the gills, and the third pumps it to the rest of the body.
Two. An octopus has blue blood, because it carries oxygen with copper instead of iron.
Three. An octopus has nine brains: one central brain, and a small one in each of its eight arms.
Octopuses really are strange and clever animals.
subject: 3 facts about octopuses
